data.name: Future Fab Heroes
data.detailed_description:
Future Fab Heroes is an educational, gamified adventure set in a high-tech research facility on Mars. Team up with your robot companion, CHIP-E, and explore the cutting-edge technologies that power the modern world. From semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging to futuristic engineering challenges, you'll learn through hands-on gameplay while building the skills needed to become a Future Fab Hero.

Learn

Welcome to the Mars Innovation Zone — a state-of-the-art research facility where innovation never stops. Explore the science and technology behind semiconductor fabrication, advanced manufacturing, and next-generation electronics through interactive activities, engaging missions, and immersive storytelling.

Train

Put your knowledge into practice through a variety of hands-on training simulations. Operate advanced equipment, solve engineering challenges, and complete fabrication-themed tasks to earn credits and experience. As you progress, unlock new costumes, upgrades, and abilities that help you tackle even greater challenges.

Challenge & Collect

Test your skills with engaging activities that reward curiosity, problem-solving, and perseverance. Complete objectives, earn achievements, collect rewards, and grow your expertise as you advance through the facility's training programs.

Defend

When alien forces threaten the Mars facility, it's time to put your training to the test. Use the experience, upgrades, and resources you've earned to strengthen your defenses in an action-packed tower defense mode. Develop strategies, unlock powerful enhancements, and protect the future of innovation from incoming extraterrestrial threats.

Explore & Discover

Journey through the Mars fabrication facility with your loyal robot companion, CHIP-E. Meet researchers, uncover new technologies, and discover how tiny chips and advanced engineering solutions power everything from everyday electronics to interplanetary exploration.

FEATURES

  • Multiple fabrication and technology-themed training simulations

  • Learn about semiconductor manufacturing and advanced engineering concepts

  • Earn currency and experience through successful performance

  • Unlock costumes and character customization options

  • Purchase upgrades and enhance your abilities

  • Progress through increasingly challenging training programs

  • Strengthen your defenses through a progression-based tower defense mode

  • Explore a futuristic research facility on Mars alongside CHIP-E

  • Earn achievements and rewards as you become a Future Fab Hero

Blast off into the future of technology, innovation, and discovery.

Are you ready to become a Future Fab Hero?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460, AMD Radeon HD 6850, or integrated graphics with DirectX 10 support
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14+ (Mohave)
  • Processor: Intel x64 (SSE2) or Apple Silicon (M1+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
